neutral-white.$description: Neutral White — Surfaces that sit on the canvas: modal, sidebar, panel, settings card, palette popover, hotkey toast.

neutral-light-grey.$description: Neutral Light Grey — Page canvas, sidebar item hover/active wash, kbd background, editable-heading hover.

neutral-grey.$description: Neutral Grey — Hairline borders on surfaces, inputs, share row, toolbar, hotkey toast.

main-orange.$description: Main Orange — Ember brand accent. Section eyebrows, sidebar section titles, active sidebar bullet, '+ New graph' hover, active tool-button outline. Outline-only — never used as a button fill.

orange-light.$description: Orange family — light tier for surfaces and node swatches.

orange-strong.$description: Orange family — strong tier (Amber font color).

purple-medium.$description: Purple family — medium tier (Lavender node swatch).

purple-strong.$description: Purple family — strong tier. Aliased as --color-cobalt-link, the system's only chromatic interactive *fill* (focus rings, checked checkbox, link-colored share URL, rubber-band selection).

green-light.$description: Green family — light tier (default Green node swatch).

green-strong.$description: Green family — strong tier. Constructive-action color (Outlined Green Pill primary CTA).

blue-medium.$description: Blue family — medium tier (Sky node swatch).

red-light.$description: Red family — light tier (Peach node swatch).

red-medium.$description: Red family — medium tier (Coral node swatch / font).

red-strong.$description: Red family — strong tier. Aliased as --red, the system's destructive / warning color (Outlined Red Pill, private warn).

yellow-light.$description: Yellow family — light tier (default Yellow node swatch).

midnight-ink.$description: Midnight Ink — Modal heading, panel heading, settings heading.

graphite-nav.$description: Graphite Nav — Sidebar item label, input value, settings item, visibility row text.

deep-slate.$description: Deep Slate — Default canvas text on the cytoscape graph.

storm.$description: Storm — Body color, modal paragraph, sidebar '+ New graph' label, toolbar text.

steel.$description: Steel — Subtitle metadata, share hint, secondary captions.

slate.$description: Slate — Outlined Slate Pill default border + label color.

ash.$description: Ash — Placeholder text, empty-state copy, default edge color.

chalk.$description: Chalk — Reserved for future low-emphasis chrome.

display.$description: Display headings only (modal h3, panel h2, settings card heading, empty-state cue). Always weight 400 — the typeface carries the emphasis, not the weight.

label.$description: UPPERCASE eyebrows and pill button labels only. Weight 600, letter-spacing 0.053em–0.125em.

body.$description: Body text, hints, captions, sidebar meta, toolbar text. Weight 400.

ui.$description: Form inputs, sidebar list items, toolbar buttons, settings list, default per-graph canvas font. Weight 500.

body-sm.$description: Modal paragraph, share hint, modal subtitle, kbd, save status. Tabular nums for timestamps and URLs.

caption.$description: Modal body text and visibility-row label.

ui-sm.$description: Tool button label, hotkey hint toast.

ui.$description: Form input value, sidebar item label, visibility row.

eyebrow.$description: Section eyebrow above modal field groups; sidebar section title.

pill-label.$description: Outlined pill button label (Slate / Green / Red).

heading-sm.$description: Modal h3 and panel h2. Inline-editable; renders the data-placeholder attribute when empty.

md.$description: Generic small radius — falls back to cardsalt.

buttons.$description: All button shapes — outlined Slate / Green / Red pills, tool buttons, share row buttons, hotkey hint, '+ New graph'.

sm.$description: One-step lift — toolbar, hotkey toast. Cool grey, soft, low-spread.

md.$description: Modal-level lift — modal, settings card, panel, palette popover.

ease-expressive.$description: Sidebar collapse/expand, panel open/close, modal enter — fast-in, slow-out 'placed-not-dropped' feel.

ease-press.$description: Active-press feedback applied to every interactive element.

panel-width.$description: Right-side editing panel default width — resizable, min 320px, max 95vw.

graphtask.design.source: graphtask/public/style.css :root[data-theme="light"] block + public/app.js COLOR_PALETTE / FONT_COLOR_PALETTE / FONTS arrays.
